title: Immune Response and Cytomegalovirus in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) Patients
brief_summary: This prospective study evaluate the immune status of patients admitted in ICU.CMV remains dormant in the body, but in people with immune deficiency, CMV could reactivate and cause life-threatening pneumonia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age more than 18-year-old
* Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* minors,
* pregnant or lactating women,
* adults under guardianship,
* immunosuppression at the entrance to resuscitation,
* AIDS
